turns.question: China is the world's biggest polluter
turns.sql:
WITH latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(`year`) AS max_year FROM `workspace`.`prove_it`.`emissions`
), ranked_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    `country`,
    `co2`,
    `year`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `co2` DESC) AS rank
  FROM `workspace`.`prove_it`.`emissions`
  WHERE `year` = (SELECT max_year FROM latest_year)
)
SELECT `country`, `co2`, `year`
FROM ranked_countries
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY rank;

turns.question: show it per person instead
turns.sql:
WITH latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX(`year`) AS max_year FROM `workspace`.`prove_it`.`emissions`
), ranked_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    `country`,
    `co2`,
    `co2_per_capita`,
    `year`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `co2_per_capita` DESC) AS rank
  FROM `workspace`.`prove_it`.`emissions`
  WHERE `year` = (SELECT max_year FROM latest_year)
    AND `co2_per_capita` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT `country`, `co2`, `co2_per_capita`, `year`
FROM ranked_countries
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY rank;
